vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v2
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: a_nullable_array_tag_present_beside_a_non_null_one
vectors.why: `CordonedLogDirs` is tag 1, nullable with a null default, so it is absent when null and carries a compact nullable array length when present. Absent and empty are different bytes and must stay different.

vectors.name: a_nullable_array_tag_that_is_empty_rather_than_null
vectors.why: An empty array is not the default and is written; a null one is the default and is omitted. The synthesized case covers null, so this is the other side of that pair.

vectors.name: synthesized_populated_v2
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, present and non-default: one element in every array, every nullable thing supplied. The defaults case leaves arrays empty, which hides every field of the struct the array would have held — a records field encoded with the wrong length prefix survived the whole corpus that way, because nothing ever reached the struct holding it.
